4.6 Termination of membership:

    ● If membership is terminated due to a critical transgression, the right to market their
         products bearing our endorsement and logo will be forfeited.

    ● If the membership is terminated due to a non-critical transgression, membership and the
         right to use our logo will not be revoked, but the member will be under probation for one
         calendar year following the ruling.

    4.7 Reinstatement of membership:

Any member whose membership was terminated due to a non-critical transgression, may, after
one calendar year from the termination, re-apply for membership. All previous transgressions
will be deemed nullified and the application will be assessed and treated like a new application.

      VI. Aggregation of produce within the PGS

6.1 Principles governing aggregation

Where a Outeniqua PGS-certified farm aggregates produce (i.e buys in ) from more than one
source, each case of aggregation must be assessed and approved by the PGS group on a
case-by-case basis, in accordance with Participatory Guarantee System principles of
transparency, trust and collective responsibility.

The following minimum criteria apply:

         ● Participation and commitment to the PGS process.
         ● The aggregating farm/entity must demonstrate active participation in PGS

             meetings, peer reviews and farm assessments, confirming commitment to the
             principles and functioning of the PGS system.
